bagPolicy.summary: Only small purses, clutches or fanny packs smaller than 16.5 cm x 11.5 cm (6.5" x 4.5") are allowed at TD Coliseum.
allowed: Small purses, clutches or fanny packs under 16.5 cm x 11.5 cm
bagPolicy.note: There is no bag check. A bag that does not meet the policy for medical or other reasons may be let in after x-ray inspection. The venue encourages fans not to bring any bag.

parking.note: There is no on-site parking at TD Coliseum, but upgraded parking can be purchased for the York Boulevard Parkade through the TD Coliseum Mobile App. Several nearby lots and garages are within walking distance, and arriving early is recommended.

rideshare.note: Guests using Uber, Lyft, or other rideshare services can be dropped off and picked up in the Vine Street lot off of James Street North.

concessions.note: TD Coliseum offers a variety of food and drink options ranging from quick-service concessions to luxury dining experiences. Highlights include local favorites and arena classics, premium dining with bespoke bars, and themed lounges like the TD Lounge and Vinyl Room. Special offerings feature Ontario cheese boards, Hamilton Brewery drafts, and Niagara wines.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by TD Coliseum, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in TD Coliseum's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Guests without access to a mobile device should contact the Box Office in advance to arrange Will Call ticket pickup on event day.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at TD Coliseum. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
